 Job Tasks and Duties:  
- Preparing Site Plans and Survey Reports. 
- Carrying out all Survey activities in accordance with the Company’s Integrated Management System. 
- Preparing Setout, WAE and Conformance Reports for the Client. 
- Maintaining accurate site records using a site diary. 
- Site Setout using both Construction Plans and 3d Design Models. 
- Analysing, Interpreting and Manipulating Data to create 3d CAD Models. 
- Directing, Supervising and Mentoring the work of Survey Technicians, as required. 

  
 Skills Required for the Role:  
- Experience with Leica Total Stations and 12d Software 
- Surveying Qualification – Degree, Diploma or 3 years work experience
- 3+ Years Previous Construction / Engineering Surveying Experience 
- Strong Verbal and Communication Skills 
- A Strong Work Ethic and Adaptability 
- Full Driving License
